name: elderindex-website
description: Independent ElderIndex website, built from the 2026 Webflow design and content

scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 -d dist
scripts.cms:test: npm --prefix cms test && playwright test --config cms/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.cms:hosted:test: npm run cms:hosted:build && node --test cms/test/hosted.test.mjs cms/hosted/state-test.mjs
scripts.cms:hosted:dry-run: npm run cms:hosted:build && cms/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --config cms/hosted/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run
